records.beforeDe: Die lernende Person kann Verbrennungsreaktionen verschiedener Kohlenwasserstoffe vergleichen und energetische Kennzahlen im Kontext diskutieren.
records.afterDe: Die lernende Person kann Verbrennungsreaktionen verschiedener Kohlenwasserstoffe vergleichen und energetische Kennzahlen auf einer gemeinsamen Bezugsbasis im jeweiligen Nutzungskontext begründet einordnen.
records.beforeEn: The learner can compare combustion reactions of various hydrocarbons and discuss energy figures in context.
records.afterEn: The learner can compare combustion reactions of different hydrocarbons and give a reasoned interpretation of energy figures on a common reference basis in the respective context of use.
records.finding: The shared comparison basis makes the existing energetic fuel comparison assessable: a ranking per mole does not determine a ranking per mass or useful output. This is one comparative combustion goal, not a new thermodynamic routine. DE/EN preserve the same meaning. The HE E.4 energetic-comparison clause is identical in the repository page 36, the old URL response page 34 and the ministry currently linked April-2026 edition page 36.
records.actualSourceLocation: HE E.4#B04A01, repository printed/physical 36; ministry current April-2026 edition printed/physical 36
records.scopeBoundary: No extrapolation from the one hydrocarbon comparison to all energetic/lifecycle competencies. Image-visible 1 kg values are assistance; the proposed description does not demand lifecycle ranking.

records.beforeDe: Die lernende Person kann wichtige Erdölprodukte Einsatzbereichen in Alltag und Technik zuordnen und ökologische Konsequenzen ihres Einsatzes begründet abschätzen.
records.afterDe: Die lernende Person kann wichtige Erdölprodukte ihren Einsatzbereichen in Alltag und Technik zuordnen und Nutzen sowie ökologische Konsequenzen ihres Einsatzes begründet bewerten.
records.beforeEn: The learner can assign important petroleum products to applications in everyday life and technology and assess ecological consequences of their use with justification.
records.afterEn: The learner can assign important petroleum products to their applications in everyday life and technology and give a reasoned assessment of the benefits and ecological consequences of their use.
records.finding: The added utility assessment supplies the substantive importance judgment missing from mere application matching. Application, material benefit and environmental consequence can be assessed together in one reasoned selection case. Qualitative everyday examples fit the cited year-9/10 competence; numerical lifecycle optimization is not required. DE/EN are equivalent.
records.actualSourceLocation: BY C9 NTG Lernbereich 5 fifth competence; C10 CH Lernbereich 3 fifth competence (deduplicated extraction label C9-NTG.5.5)
records.scopeBoundary: The live C10 parallel is Lernbereich 3, not a live C10.5.5 location. Keep normalized deduplication identity but cite the actual source location. Other-state rows and a graphical list of products are not independently approved source proof.

records.beforeDe: Die lernende Person kann unterschiedliche Reaktionssysteme unterscheiden, Wärme und Arbeit als Formen der Energieänderung in einem geschlossenen System mit variablem Volumen beschreiben und innere Energie bzw. Reaktionsenergie von Enthalpie bzw. Reaktionsenthalpie abgrenzen.
records.afterDe: Die lernende Person kann unterschiedliche Reaktionssysteme unterscheiden, Wärme und Arbeit als Formen der Energieänderung in einem geschlossenen System mit variablem Volumen beschreiben und die Änderung der inneren Energie (Reaktionsenergie) von der Änderung der Enthalpie (Reaktionsenthalpie) abgrenzen.
records.beforeEn: The learner can distinguish different reaction systems, describe heat and work as forms of energy change in a closed system with variable volume, and distinguish internal energy or reaction energy from enthalpy or reaction enthalpy.
records.afterEn: The learner can distinguish different reaction systems, describe heat and work as forms of energy change in a closed system with variable volume, and distinguish the change in internal energy (reaction energy) from the change in enthalpy (reaction enthalpy).
records.finding: Replacing state quantities with changes corrects a factual category error: U and H are properties of a state, reaction energy/enthalpy are their changes. Boundary types, heat/work exchange and the delta distinction serve one thermodynamic explanation. BY GA/EA explicitly link the elements by a single explanation purpose; no independent split is warranted. DE/EN are equivalent.
records.actualSourceLocation: BY C12 GA/EA Lernbereich 5 third competence; content thermodynamic systems and constant-volume/constant-pressure reaction heat
records.scopeBoundary: Any quantitative Qv=deltaU/Qp=deltaH use must state no non-volume work. Isolated means no heat, work or matter exchange, not merely adiabatic+closed. The current image can support the restricted volume-work model only.

records.beforeDe: Die lernende Person kann Unterschiede experimentell bestimmter oder vorgegebener Reaktionsenthalpien auf Grundlage der Bindungsverhältnisse begründen und Systeme als energiereich oder energiearm einstufen.
records.afterDe: Die lernende Person kann Unterschiede experimentell bestimmter oder vorgegebener Reaktionsenthalpien auf Grundlage der Bindungsverhältnisse begründen und die verglichenen Edukt- und Produktsysteme relativ zueinander als energiereich oder energiearm einstufen.
records.beforeEn: The learner can justify differences in experimentally determined or given reaction enthalpies based on bonding relationships and classify systems as energy-rich or energy-poor.
records.afterEn: The learner can justify differences in experimentally determined or given reaction enthalpies based on bonding relationships and classify the compared reactant and product systems as energy-rich or energy-poor relative to one another.
records.finding: Adding compared reactant/product systems and relativity removes an unjustified absolute energy-rich label. Bond-breaking costs energy; forming bonds releases energy; their competition explains the relative reaction enthalpy. This is one causal molecular energy comparison. Both GA and EA target qualitative molecule/combustion-heat relationships and expressly exclude calculations there, separate from their next formation-enthalpy calculation competence. DE/EN are equivalent.
records.actualSourceLocation: BY C12 GA/EA Lernbereich 5 fourth competence; content qualitative molecule/combustion-heat relationship
records.scopeBoundary: Given evaluated model budgets may support explanation; independently summing tabulated average bond energies must not become a completion requirement. Gas-phase average-bond model does not exactly predict arbitrary condensed-phase enthalpy.
